builds.desc: Operative buffs really help Yrliet pump out some damage. Sniper is still the weakest setup in rogue trader but with unique aeldari options Yrliet is far stronger than she has been since the operative/assassin nerf from launch

4.d: If the Operative has not moved this turn, they gain +PER bonus Ballistic Skill and +(INT bonus / 2) damage for every 5 cells between them and the target.

5.d: Grants +10% bonus to dodg

6.d: If the Operative attacks a target affected by an exploit from a distance of (15 - PER bonus) cells or farther, that attack deals +15% damage.

7.d: For the next attack against a target affected by an exploit, that target's cover fficiency will be reduced by -(15 + (PER bonus/3 x stacks of exploit))%. This attack will have +(15 + PER bonus/3- x stacks of exploit)% hit chance.

8.d: Whenever the Operative attacks an enemy that is at full wounds, that attack deals +(10 + PER bonus)% more damage to that enemy.
Grants +2 movement points.

11.d: The Operative inflicts an exploit even on enemies which are out of the Operative's line of sight at the start of the turn.

12.d: While in cover, the Operative gains +25% cover efficiency, +15 Perception, and +15 Ballistic Skill. This effect lasts until the Operative moves. Does not stack.
Enemies suffer a -20% penalty to dodge against las weapon attacks.

13.d: Precise Attack grants the Operative a bonus to Perception equal to (number of exploits removed / 2) (minimum 1) .

17.d:
The Bounty Hunter makes a free single attack with the selected weapon. That attack always hits, does not end the Bounty Hunter's movement, but deals just (4 × (BS bonus + PER bonus))% of usual damage.
 After each third enemy killed by Claim the Bounty, the Bounty Hunter recovers +1 charge of Hunt Down the Prey.
 Prey: if Claim the Bounty kills a target marked as prey, the Bounty Hunter receives +2 AP.

18.d: Whenever an enemy is killed by a critical hit scored by the Bounty Hunter or their ally, the Bounty Hunter gains +(2 X enemy's difficulty tier)% damage or 2 rounds.

20.d: When Yrliet kills a target with a single shot attack from Aeldari weapon for the first time in a round, she immediately gains an additional attack

21.d: Whenever the Bounty Hunter scores a critical hit, they gain +PER bonus% armour penetration until the end of combat. Stacks.

22.d:
The Bounty Hunter's next attack this turn will have additional effects:
 Deals an additional +BS bonus damage.
 Enemy's armour will be reduced by −(3 × target difficulty tier)% against all the Bounty Hunter's attacks until the end of combat.
 If Cull the Bold lowers the enemy's armour below 20%, the enemy's dodge is also decreased by −(3 × target difficulty tier)% against all the Bounty Hunter's attacks until the end of combat, and the Bounty Hunter's next attack this turn deals an additional +(BS bonus +(greater of PER and INT bonus)) damage.
 Prey: if the target of the attack is marked as prey, the armour and dodge reduction granted by Cull the Bold also work for the attacks of the Bounty Hunter's allies.

23.d: Whenever the Bounty Hunter kills prey whose difficulty tier is IV or higher, the Bounty Hunter additionally gains +2 AP.

24.d: Critical Dmage dealt by this character's Aeldari ranged weapons is increased by PER

25.d: When the Bounty Hunter performs a single-shot attack on an immobilised or stunned target, this attack refunds its cost and does not count for the attack limit. Once per round.

28.d: Whenever prey that is not being trailed is killed by an ally, the Bounty Hunter gains an extra turn with half of their MP and AP. The Bounty Hunter cannot attack during this extra turn.

30.d:
The Bounty Hunter sets a trap on a free cell in a 10-cell radius around them. Any enemy entering the 2-cell radius around that trap activates the trap:
 Each enemy in a 2-cell radius around that trap suffers (2 × (greater of Bounty Hunter’s PER and INT bonus)) direct damage and must pass an Agility resistance test with a −(2 × (greater of Bounty Hunter’s PER and INT bonus)) penalty or become immobilised until the enemy's next turn. 
 The Bounty Hunter gains +AGI bonus MP at the beginning of their next turn. 
 Prey: a target marked as prey is always immobilised until their next turn.

31.d: Whenever the Bounty Hunter kills an enemy whose difficulty tier is IV or higher, the Bounty Hunter immediately reloads their weapon and attacks the closest enemy in their line of sight. This attack gains +50% overpenetration but deals only (4 x (BS bonus + PER bonus))% of the Bounty Hunter's usual damage.

33.d: Cull the Bold additionally removes -target's difficulty tier deflection, -(2 X target's difficuIty tier) Willpower, and -(2 X target's difficulty tier) Toughness from the target.

34.d: Allows Aeldari character to equip Drukhari equipment

36.d: Every round, after the character kills the first enemy, the character immediately makes an additional single attack against the closest enemy they can target with the same weapon if possible. This attack deals 30% base damage with a +10% bonus for every difficulty tier of the first killed enemy, i.e. if the enemy was of difficulty tier 1, this attack deals 40% damage in total.
Whenever the Operative triggers an exploit on an enemy, the Operative gains +1 damage and +2% armour penetration until the end of combat. Stacks.

37.d: Whenever the Bounty Hunter is attacked in melee range for the first time since the end of their turn, they automatically dodge that attack and move 1 cell in the opposite direction from the enemy. The Bounty Hunter does not provoke attack of opportunity with this movement.

38.d: first grenade use in combat does not spend AP and does not count toward the attack limit that turn.

39.d:
The Operative removes -1 exploit from each enemy in a 5-cell radius around a point within 10 cells from the Operative. If there is only one enemy in the area, the Operative removes all exploit stacks from that enemy.
 All allies gain +(number of removed exploits)% armour until the end of combat. If 4 or more exploits are removed, the Operative gains +(2 x number of removed exploits)% damage until the end of combat.

40.d:
Deadeye shot deals an additional +(2 x PER bonus)% damage. The following ranged attack abilities gain deadeye shot benefits (x 1.5 range and the additional damage from the talent itself): -Bounty Hunter's Claim the Bounty
  -Master Tactician's Finish the Job -Assassin's Death Whisper -Assassin's Killing Edge -Assassin's Dispatch -Operative's Dismantling Attack -Bounty Hunter's Wild Hunt.
Each enemy affected by Piercing Shot has their armour reduced by -BS bonus% until the end of combat. Stacks.

41.d: Tactical Knowledge requires 3 exploits instead of 4. The Operative's damage is increased by +INT bonus.

42.d:
The Bounty Hunter designates an enemy in a 10-cell radius as trailed and finishes the turn.
 Trailed:
 All allies gain +7% hit chance against a trailed enemy, +15% if the enemy's difficulty tier is more than or equal to V.
 If an ally kills a trailed enemy:
 The Bounty Hunter gains an additional turn after that ally's turn, with all AP and MP remaining from the moment the Bounty Hunter used Hot on the Trail.
 The Bounty Hunter gains an additional +(2 + target difficulty tier / 2) MP.
 The cooldown of Hot on the Trail is reset.
 When Hot on the Trail is used for the third time during combat, the Bounty Hunter recovers +1 charge of Hunt Down the Prey.

43.d: Hot on the Trail now has an unlimited range and reduces the target's armour by -(3 + PER bonus)% for 2 rounds.

44.d: If the character's dodge reduction is higher than the enemy's dodge, the character's damage against that enemy is increased by +1% for every 5% difference between the character's dodge reduction and the enemy's dodge.

Whenever the character deals damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the degraded defence effect for every 6 damage that the character has dealt. Whenever an ally attacks that enemy, they deal additional damage equal to the number of degraded defence stacks. (Stacks cap 1000)

47.d: If the target of Analyse Enemies has 2 or more exploits, that target suffers +1 additional exploit.

48.d: Whenever an ally kills prey, the Bounty Hunter gains half of the bonuses granted by Hunt Down the Prey.

50.d: Any damage the character deals is increased by +1 for every attack they have made this combat. Does not affect damage-over-time effects: bleeding, burning, or toxin.
Perfect Spot additionally grants the Operative +(5 + PER bonus)% armour penetration against enemies that are 7 cells away or farther.

51.d: Whenever prey is killed, all enemies in a 10-cell radius around the prey have their Agility reduced by -(5 X prey's difficulty tier) for 2 rounds.

52.d: Expose Weakness also reduces enemies' Toughness and Willpower by -(3 X INT bonus) for 1 round.
Character gains +13 to skill and can re-roll failed skill tests +1

 Lethality: a specific Assassin's characteristic that is equal to dodge or dodge penetration, whichever is higher.

21.d: Whenever the Assassin deals direct damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the vulnerable effect. Vulnerable: the character suffers +(number of vulnerable stacks) X PER bonus% more damage from the Assassin's attacks. Direct Damage: damage that cannot be reduced by the target's parameters or bonuses.

22.d:
The Assassin attacks and grants +40% dodge to the target for this attack. If this attack hits, it deals an additional +(lethality / 5) (rounded down) damage increased by twice the percentage of that target's missing wounds.
 Lethality: a specific Assassin parameter that is equal to dodge or dodge reduction, whichever is higher.

23.d: Whenever the Assassin deals 5 or more direct damage to an enemy with a single attack, the Assassin gains +10 lethality until the end of combat. Stacks.

24.d: When Yrliet kills a target with a single shot attack from Aeldari weapon for the first time in a round, she immediately gains an additional attack

25.d: The Assassin gains +Lethality% chance to deal +5% of target's max wounds more damage to an opening.

28.d: Critical Dmage dealt by this character's Aeldari ranged weapons is increased by PER
Whenever the Assassin hits an opening, the Assassin's damage is increased by +(AGI bonus / 2)% until the end of combat. Stacks.

30.d:
The Assassin dashes in a straight line for up to (1 + AGI bonus / 2) cells, suffering −Assassin’s WS bonus less damage from attacks of opportunity and gaining +(2 × Assassin’s AGI bonus)% dodge against the enemies they dash through until the next Assassin's turn.
 If the Assassin hasn't dashed through any enemies, at the end of their turn they gain +(2 × (greater of Assassin’s PER and INT bonus))% cover efficiency to their cover until the Assassin moves.
 Doesn't stack with itself.
 After the first use, the Assassin can use this ability again for free.

33.d: Whenever the Assassin deals direct damage, the target must pass an Agility resistance test with a -(2 X Assassin's AGI bonus) penalty or become slowed until the end of their next turn.

42.d:
For 1 round the Assassin becomes the lowest priority target for enemy attacks and gains Elusive:
 the Assassin can move through enemies
 the Assassin gains + AGI bonus % dodge and +PER bonus % dodge penetration
 the Assassin's attacks deal +10% additional damage
 all half cover provides the Assassin 50% cover efficiency.
 Elusive fades when the Assassin attacks.

builds.title: Ulfar the Grey Hunter with Bolt Pistol
builds.desc: Mixed attacker ulfar with new gear is very enjoyable, not Argenta levels of damage but much more fitting for an astartes

4.d: Whenever the Soldier deals damage, their critical damage is increased by +1% until the end of combat.

5.d: Reloading costs -2 AP less (minimum 1). The first reload in a combat does not cost AP.

6.d: The Soldier gives a sign that they are about to open fire. The Soldier and their allies will automatically dodge the Soldier's next attack.

7.d: Grants +15% bonus to parry.

8.d: After the Soldier deals damage to 3 different enemies, the Soldier gains +(10 + 2 X BS bonus)% more damage for their next attack in the current combat.

10.d: Each shot fired by the Soldier grants them +1 Agility until the end of their next turn.

11.d:
The Soldier's next burst attacks will have its rate of fire doubled but deal -25% less damage. All the shots will follow random trajectories.
 Only works with weapons capable of burst fire.

12.d: The character can attack with the second weapon in their current weapon set in addition to the usual one attack per round. This attack suffers a -20 penalty to WS and BS and costs +1 AP more.
12.ru: Бой с применением двух видов оружия

13.d: Rapid Fire no longer reduces damage.
Increases wounds by half of the character's level (rounded up).

14.d: Chain weapon attacks gain +4 maximum damage.

17.d: The Arch-Militant makes a melee attack with a kick, dealing (TGH bonus + STR bonus) damage instead of weapon damage. This attack does not count toward the attack limit per turn and counts as a single melee attack for the purposes of Versatility. This attack cannot be parried and will push the target 2 cells away.

18.d: Targets of Kick must pass a Toughness resistance test with a -(2 X Arch- Militant's STR bonus) penalty or fall prone for 1 round.

21.d: The Arch-Militant begins combat with 2 stacks of versatility.

22.d: The Arch-Militant's next attack will cost 0 AP, will not count toward the attack limit this turn. The cost of this ability is reduced by -1 for every 4 stacks of versatility (min 1).
Bolt weapon attacks gain +10% armour penetration.

23.d: When entering combat the Arch-Militant gains +(2 X BS bonus) Weapon Skill, and +(2 X WS bonus) Ballistic Skill until end of combat.

24.d: Death world characters gain +15% critical hit chance against targets with the bleeding effect or with 50% or less of their maximum wounds

25.d: Killing an enemy with a melee attack makes all the Arch-Militant's ranged attacks this turn cost -1 AP (min 1), and vice versa. Does not stack.

28.d: The cost of Wildfire is reduced by -1 AP for every 3 stacks of versatility instead of 4.

29.d: Enemies gain no melee superiority bonuses against this character.

30.d: The Arch-Militant immediately gains +(3 + Arch-Militant's AGI bonus) MP. If the Arch-Militant has stacks of versatility, they gain +3 more stacks until the end of turn.

31.d: The Arch-Militant gains a +(5 + stack of versatility)% bonus to armour. This bonus is kept when the Arch-Militant uses Cautious Approach or Confident Approach.

33.d: Gaining a stack of versatility increases critical hit chance by +5% until the end turn. Stacks.

34.d: first grenade use in combat does not spend AP and does not count toward the attack limit that turn.

36.d: During the first turn of combat, the character has +2 additional action points.
Revel in Slaughter can be used after 2 kills instead of 3.

37.d: The Arch-Militant gains a +(5 + number of Versatility stacks)% bonus to critical damage. This bonus is kept when the Arch-Militant uses Cautious Approach or Confident Approach.

38.d: Grants +2 movement points.

39.d:
The Soldier immediately spends all their AP and MP and gains a +30% bonus to cover efficiency.
 The next time the Soldier uses Run and Gun, they gain back all spent AP and MP plus 1 additional AP. It also resets the 7 cooldown of all other Soldier's abilities except for Run and Gun.

40.d: Whenever the character deals damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the degraded defence effect for every 6 damage that the character has dealt. Whenever an ally attacks that enemy, they deal additional damage equal to the number of degraded defence stacks. (Stacks cap 1000)
The Arch-Militant deals +20% critical damage against targets that are stunned, prone, or blinded.

41.d: Each shot fired by the Soldier grants them +1 Agility until the end of their next turn.

42.d:
The Arch-Militant's next attack, if it hit, will cause all the targets to make a Toughness resistance test with a −(2 × Arch-Militant's BS bonus or WS bonus, whichever is higher) penalty. If failed, the targets will suffer a negative effect based on the attack's damage type:
 Impact damage knocks the target prone for 1 round.
 Piercing and rending damage inflict bleeding and slowed on the target until the end of combat.
 Energy and all other damage inflict blinded on the target until the end of combat.
 Power swords and power axes count as both energy and rending, while power hammers count as both energy and impact. Attacks that combine several types of damage will benefit from each additional effect.

43.d: Devastating Attack also reduces the target's armour by -7% and Toughness by -10 until the end of combat. Does not stack.
Power weapon attacks gain +10% armour penetration.

44.d: Every character's melee attack reduces the target's armour by STR% until the end of combat. This reduction is applied before damage is calculated. Stacks.

46.d: All of the Soldier's area attacks gain +(5 + 3 X BS bonus)% armour penetration and ignore (BS bonus / 2) deflection when used against enemies in a 3-cell radius around the Soldier.
The first hit of each burst attacks deals additional damage equal to the weapon's current rate of fire.

47.d: The Soldier's second attack action in a turn deals +(5 + 2 x AGI bonus)% more damage to enemies that have not suffered damage from the Soldier during this turn.

48.d: When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their armour reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant deals +10% damage. When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their deflection reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant deals +2 damage.

50.d: The character gains a bonus to their Strength equal to 20% of their maximum wounds.
For each adjacent ally, the Soldier deals +(5 + BS bonus)% more damage to enemies.

51.d: Any of the Arch-Militant's burst attacks and melee area attacks reduce dodge of all the enemies hit by -8% until the end of combat. Does not stack.

52.d: When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their dodge reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant gains +10% critical hit chance. When the Arch-Militant attacks targets that have their parry reduced by any effects applied by the Arch-Militant's allies, the Arch-Militant deals +20% critical damage.
Death world characters gain +10% to critical hit chance for axes, hammers, and las weapons.

53.d:
The Soldier immediately dashes in the selected direction, spending all their Movement points. Does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Allows the Soldier to dash through allies and enemies but not through obstacles.
 Can only be used once per round.

54.d: Any damage the character deals is increased by +1 for every attack they have made this combat. Does not affect damage-over-time effects: bleeding, burning, or toxin.
Whenever the Arch-Militant or their ally uses a heroic act or a desperate measure, the Arch-Militant gains +1 and +10 damage for all attacks until the end of combat.

17.d:

18.d: Whenever the Bounty Hunter scores a critical hit for the first time in a round, they gain +target's difficulty tier movement points.

22.d:

 Deals an additional +BS bonus damage.

 If Cull the Bold lowers the enemy's armour below 20%, the enemy's dodge is also decreased by −(3 × target difficulty tier)% against all the Bounty Hunter's attacks until the end of combat, and the Bounty Hunter's next attack this turn deals an additional +(BS bonus +(greater of PER and INT bonus)) damage.

23.d: Cull the Bold additionally removes -target's difficulty tier deflection, -(2 X target's difficuIty tier) Willpower, and -(2 X target's difficulty tier) Toughness from the target.

25.d: Whenever an enemy is killed by a critical hit scored by the Bounty Hunter or their ally, the Bounty Hunter gains +(2 X enemy's difficulty tier)% damage or 2 rounds.

28.d: Whenever the Bounty Hunter kills prey whose difficulty tier is IV or higher, the Bounty Hunter additionally gains +2 AP.

 Each enemy in a 2-cell radius around that trap suffers (2 × (greater of Bounty Hunter’s PER and INT bonus)) direct damage and must pass an Agility resistance test with a −(2 × (greater of Bounty Hunter’s PER and INT bonus)) penalty or become immobilised until the enemy's next turn.

31.d: Whenever the Bounty Hunter kills an enemy whose difficulty tier is IV or higher, the Bounty Hunter immediately reloads their weapon and attacks the closest enemy in their line of sight. This attack gains +50% overpenetration but deals only (4 x (BS bonus + PER bonus))% of the Bounty Hunter's usual damage.

33.d: Each enemy affected by Piercing Shot has their armour reduced by -BS bonus% until the end of combat. Stacks.

34.d: Whilst Regimental tactics effect lasts, the commander and their allies weapon attacks gain +20% dodge reduction, parry reduction, block reduction and cover penetration that have been attacked by allies this combat

36.d: During the first turn of combat, the character has +2 additional action points.
After the Soldier deals damage to 3 different enemies, the Soldier gains +(10 + 2 X BS bonus)% more damage for their next attack in the current combat.

37.d: Whenever the Bounty Hunter is attacked in melee range for the first time since the end of their turn, they automatically dodge that attack and move 1 cell in the opposite direction from the enemy. The Bounty Hunter does not provoke attack of opportunity with this movement.

38.d: first grenade use in combat does not spend AP and does not count toward the attack limit that turn.

39.d:
The Soldier immediately spends all their AP and MP and gains a +30% bonus to cover efficiency.

40.d: Whenever the character deals damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the degraded defence effect for every 6 damage that the character has dealt. Whenever an ally attacks that enemy, they deal additional damage equal to the number of degraded defence stacks. (Stacks cap 1000)
Whenever prey is killed, all enemies in a 10-cell radius around the prey have their Agility reduced by -(5 X prey's difficulty tier) for 2 rounds.

41.d: The Soldier's second attack action in a turn deals +(5 + 2 x AGI bonus)% more damage to enemies that have not suffered damage from the Soldier during this turn.

42.d:
The Bounty Hunter designates an enemy in a 10-cell radius as trailed and finishes the turn.
 Trailed:
 All allies gain +7% hit chance against a trailed enemy, +15% if the enemy's difficulty tier is more than or equal to V.
 If an ally kills a trailed enemy:
 The Bounty Hunter gains an additional turn after that ally's turn, with all AP and MP remaining from the moment the Bounty Hunter used Hot on the Trail.
 The Bounty Hunter gains an additional +(2 + target difficulty tier / 2) MP.
 The cooldown of Hot on the Trail is reset.
 When Hot on the Trail is used for the third time during combat, the Bounty Hunter recovers +1 charge of Hunt Down the Prey.

43.d: Hot on the Trail now has an unlimited range and reduces the target's armour by -(3 + PER bonus)% for 2 rounds.

Fortress world characters gain +7 to Ballistic Skill, Perception, and Willpower while in combat. Yet while out of combat, their Intelligence, Fellowship, Perception, and Willpower are decreased by -7.

44.d: Any damage the character deals is increased by +1 for every attack they have made this combat. Does not affect damage-over-time effects: bleeding, burning, or toxin.

46.d: Each shot fired by the Soldier grants them +1 Agility until the end of their next turn.

47.d: While the Soldier has full cover against an enemy, the Soldier gains +10% damage against that enemy, and the enemy's attacks deal -20% less damage against the Soldier and their cover if the cover is present at the moment when the shot is fired (even if the cover is destroyed by the shot).
For each adjacent ally, the Soldier deals +(5 + BS bonus)% more damage to enemies.

48.d: Whenever prey that is not being trailed is killed by an ally, the Bounty Hunter gains an extra turn with half of their MP and AP. The Bounty Hunter cannot attack during this extra turn.

50.d: If the character's dodge reduction is higher than the enemy's dodge, the character's damage against that enemy is increased by +1% for every 5% difference between the character's dodge reduction and the enemy's dodge.
The Soldier's medium armour does not reduce dodge.

51.d: Whenever an ally kills prey, the Bounty Hunter gains half of the bonuses granted by Hunt Down the Prey.

52.d: When the Bounty Hunter performs a single-shot attack on an immobilised or stunned target, this attack refunds its cost and does not count for the attack limit. Once per round.

Two-handed las weapons equiped by the commander or allies gain a bayonet strike single melee attack that costs 1 ap. This attacks deals the same damage as the las weapon and does not count to attack limit.

53.d: The Soldier gives a sign that they are about to open fire. The Soldier and their allies will automatically dodge the Soldier's next attack.

54.d: Whenever the character scores a critical hit, they have a chance to increase their critical damage bonus by half. That chance is equal to (character's critical chance - 50)% (minumum of 0%).
Each shot fired by the Soldier grants them +1 Agility until the end of their next turn.

4.d: Half of the bonus granted by the Voice of Command remain until the end of combat. This bonus does not stack with itself or with bonuses granted by Voice of Command but does count as an Officer ability effect for the purposes of other talent effects.

18.d: At the start of combat, the Grand Strategist gains one random unknown stratagem and can use it until the end of combat for 0 AP.

21.d: Allies gain the ability to reposition the Combat Tactics area they are currently at the cost of 1 AP.

22.d: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the Combat Tactics areas. For 1 round, all allies within the range of (Grand Strategist’s INT + FEL bonus) cells gain the ability to move to that area. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and does not spend MP.

23.d: After the use of Combat Locus Stratagem, one of the areas removed by Combat Locus Stratagem can be recreated immediately.

24.d: first grenade use in combat does not spend AP and does not count toward the attack limit that turn.

25.d: If there are no enemies in the Backline area, the first attack in the turn made by every ally in that area costs -1 AP less.

30.d:

 Covering:
 Enemies suffer −(5 + 2 × (Grand Strategist’s INT + FEL bonus)) Ballistic Skill, −25% rate of fire, and −(5 + (Grand Strategist’s INT + FEL bonus)) Weapon Skill during attacks against these allies.
 Additionally, melee enemies have their MP reduced by −3, and ranged enemies will try to get behind cover. An enemy counts as a melee enemy if they have at least one melee weapon.
 ! This additional effect does not work on some stronger enemies.

31.d: Willpower resistance tests forced by Overwhelming Stratagem are made with a -(5 + 2 X (INT + FEL bonus)) penalty.
When an Imperial world character is affected by an ally's non-damaging ability or affects an ally with such an ability, their resolve is increased by (FEL bonus / 2) for 1 round.

33.d: Using a stratagem on a Backline area grants allies in the area +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% increased critical hit chance against enemies they are protected by cover from.

36.d: During the first turn of combat, the character has +2 additional action points.
Allow officers and allies under the effect of the officer's Voice of Command to deal additional damage to enemies that have not yet acted in this combat.

37.d: Each ally in the Rear area gains +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% critical hit chance if there are no enemies in a 5-cell radius around the ally.

38.n: Better to die for the Emperor
38.d: While under 40% wounds, Imperial world characters gain a +10 bonus to all characteristics and +2 to resolve.

39.d:
The target's next attack will ignore cover and will have double the effective distance.
 If the target is under the effect of voice of command, this attack will ignore enemy dodge. Additionally, the damage from this attack can't be reduced below (30 + 3 x FEL bonus)% for any reason.

40.d: If an extra turn given by the character's abilities or talents grants MP, the target gains +4 additional MP; if AP - the target gains +1 additional AP.
Allies, including the Grand Strategist, in the same Combat Tactics area with the Grand Strategist gain +(3 + INT bonus / 2) Perception and Agility.

41.d: Take Aim! also increases the damage of the next ranged attack by 5% + 1% for each cell between the attacker and the target.

42.d: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the Combat Tactics areas. For 1 round, all enemies in that area are forced to re-roll successful dodge and parry tests against all attacks. Any enemies that suffer damage and are left with less than (2 × (Grand Strategist’s INT + FEL bonus)) wounds, immediately die.

43.d: Re-rolls forced by Killzone Stratagem are made with a -15 penalty.
Whenever the commander or their allies performs a heroic act, all the commander's characteristics are increased by +7 until the end of combat

44.d: When allies take actions on extra turns given by the character, they deal +15% more damage.

46.d: Whenever the Officer targets an ally with an action (an ability or an attack), that ally's resolve is increased by +1 until the end of the Officer's next turn. This effect stacks and is prolonged until the end of the Officer's next turn each time it stacks. Cannot be prolonged past the Officer's next turn.

47.d: Allies under the effect of the Officer's abilities gain a bonus to their Weapon Skill equal to (3 + Officer's FEL bonus) and will deal +FEL bonus more damage on attacks of opportunity until the start of the Officer's next turn.

48.d: Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area for the second time in a turn refunds 1 AP. This effect can be activated once per turn.

50.d: Whenever the character deals damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the degraded defence effect for every 6 damage that the character has dealt. Whenever an ally attacks that enemy, they deal additional damage equal to the number of degraded defence stacks. (Stacks cap 1000)
Whenever the Officer makes an attack, they gain +5 Fellowship until the end of combat.

51.d: If there are more enemies than allies in the Frontline area, all allies in the area gain +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% to parry and dodge. If there are more allies than enemies in the Frontline area, all allies in the area deal +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% damage.

52.d: Targets of Move! Move! Move! gain a +10% bonus to dodge and a +10% bonus to cover efficiency until the start of the Officer's next turn.
If no other character in the current party is from an Imperial world, the first use of any of the character's archetype abilities costs -1 AP less.

53.d: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the Combat Tactics areas. For 1 round, allies in that area gain +(3 + (Grand Strategist’s INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% armour, cannot be overpenetrated, gain immunity to the prone effect, and gain +((Grand Strategist’s INT + FEL bonus) / 4) deflection against area attacks. Additionally, they do not suffer injuries for receiving damage.

54.d: After an ally takes an extra turn provided 1 by the character, the ally gains +7% armour, +7% dodge, and +3 movement points until the end of combat. Does not stack.
Every time allies under the effect of Stronghold Stratagem should have suffered an injury, they gain +(INT + FEL bonus) temporary wounds instead.

Hammer of the Emperor is a Sanctioned Psyker — Sanctic Ability,

Allies in a 3 cell radius around the Arbitrator deal 5+coercion / 20)% more damage. Does not stack

 If the target attacks the Warrior during this round, the Warrior gains +1 AP (once per round).

4.d: The Bladedancer's Medicae is now determined by Weapon Skill instead of Intelligence (if their Weapon Skill is higher). The Bladedancer deals + (5 + Medicae / 10)% critical damage and can use medikits as if having Medicae skill advancement or the corresponding feature or talent.

5.d: Each level of psy rating provides the psyker access to new psychic powers. It also strengthens damaging psychic powers. 1.

6.d:
This ability costs (5 + Bladedancer's level / 2) wounds to use.
 
The Bladedancer targets a single enemy, vowing to dispatch their mark. The Bladedancer's next attack against their selected enemy cannot be dodged or parried. If this attack kills the target, the Bladedancer regains +(5 + 2 x TGH bonus) wounds and gains +1 AP along with an additional attack this turn.
 
 This ability can be used multiple times per turn, but it grants +1 AP and an additional attack only once per round.

7.d: Whenever the Bladedancer uses an ability that costs wounds, they gain +3 MP in the current turn.

8.d: Enemies adjacent to the psyker suffer +10% more damage.

10.d: Whenever the Bladedancer dodges an attack made by an enemy who attacks them for the first time, the Bladedancer gains +1 charge of Death From Above.

11.d:
The Bladedancer immediately returns to the cell where they started their turn. This
 movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If the Bladedancer used Death From Above this turn, this movement repeats all uses of this ability in reverse.
The Bladedancer's melee area attacks cost -1 AP less (but not less than 1).

13.d: Critical hits scored by anyone within the psyker's line of sight (including the psyker themselves) increase the psyker's critical damage by +1% until the end of combat. Stacks.

14.d: each attack made by the Bladedancer increases the damage of all subsequent attacks they make this turn by +5%. This effect stacks up to 3 times. Area attacks, burst attacks (including the Blade Dance), and any other attacks that deal multiple hits are considered single attacks.

17.d:
The target ally or the Master Tactician gains +1 resolve for every 5 stacks of tactical advantage the Master Tactician has, but the Master Tactician loses half of their stacks of tactical advantage (rounded up). This effect stacks and lasts until the end of combat.
 Until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn, the Master Tactician gains stacks of tactical advantage equal to (20 + 3 × Master Tactician’s FEL bonus)% of all momentum the target gains (instead of the usual 20%).

18.d: Using Linchpin now spends only 1/4 of tactical advantage stacks instead of 1/2.

21.d: The Operative's allies gain +Operative's INT bonus / 2 hit chance and critical hit chance while attacking targets affected by exploits.

22.d:
The target gains +5% damage and +5% additional damage for every 10 stacks of tactical advantage the Master Tactician has, but the Master Tactician loses half of their stacks of tactical advantage (rounded up). This effect stacks and lasts until the end of combat.
 If the target uses a heroic act before the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn, they regain +25 momentum.

23.d: The target of Inspire gains +1 additional damage for every 10 stacks of tactical advantage until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn.

24.d: Force weapon attacks deal +psy rating more damage and have +(5 X psy rating)% more armour penetration.

25.d: The Master Tactician begins combat with additional stacks of tactical advantage equal to the number of enemies.

28.d: All the Master Tactician's abilities work as if the Master Tactician has FEL bonus more stacks of tactical advantage.

30.d: Each level of psy rating provides the psyker access to new psychic powers. It also strengthens damaging psychic powers 2.

Shield of the Emperor is a Sanctioned Psyker — Sanctic Ability,
Until the start of the psyker's next turn, all allies affected by Word of the Emperor increase their deflection by +(psyker's psy rating / 2) (minimum +1) and armour by +(10 + ally's resolve / 2)%. ! This psychic power can only be used while there is at least one ally affected by Word of the Emperor.

31.d: Every critical hit scored by the Master Tactician grants them momentum equal to (resolve / 2). Works up to 3 times per turn.

33.d: The Master Tactician deals +12% more damage to targets with less than 50% wounds and heals +20% more wounds for targets with less than 50% wounds.

34.d: Each level of psy rating provides the psyker access to new psychic powers. It also strengthens damaging psychic powers. 3.

36.d: During the first turn of combat, the character has +2 additional action points.
Death From Above deals double damage to enemies that have less than 50% wounds.

37.d: Whenever the Master Tactician spends tactical advantage stacks on abilities, the critical damage dealt by the Master Tactician increases by +1% for every stack spent until the end of the turn.

38.d: Each level of psy rating provides the psyker access to new psychic powers. It also strengthens damaging psychic powers. 4.

39.d:
Hammer of the Emperor is a Sanctioned Psyker — Sanctic Ability,
All allies affected by Word of the Emperor gain the hammer of the Emperor effect. Next time they deal damage, this damage is increased by +(5 × psyker's psy rating + ally's resolve / 2), and the effect is removed. ! This psychic power can only be used while there is at least one ally affected by Word of the Emperor.

40.d: Whenever the character deals damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the degraded defence effect for every 6 damage that the character has dealt. Whenever an ally attacks that enemy, they deal additional damage equal to the number of degraded defence stacks. (Stacks cap 1000)
Press the Advantage ignores cover and dodge.

41.d: As long as the Bladedancer has two swords equipped, the Bladedancer's Weapon Skill is increased by +AGI bonus.

42.d:
Sword of Faith is a Sanctioned Psyker — Sanctic Ability,
This psychic power costs 50 momentum and can only be used when momentum is 175 or higher. Until the end of combat, the weapon in the psyker's hand is replaced by a sword made of sheer will.

This sword has a single-target attack and an area attack (like a two-handed sword) and can be used to release a cone of fire or a line of fire (like a flamer).
The damage of this sword is the same as that of Purge Soul (with all the same bonuses).
If the psyker was using a force weapon, all the bonuses from that force weapon remain. For the purposes of talents and other bonuses, the Sword of Faith counts as a force weapon.
This power can be used again, increasing the damage of the sword by +Psyker's resolve.

43.d: Every enemy killed by the Master Tactician increases the Master Tactician's resolve by +1 until the end of combat.
The psyker's psy rating is increased by +1 until the end of combat every time an ally uses a heroic act.

44.d: Every character's melee attack reduces the target's armour by STR% until the end of combat. This reduction is applied before damage is calculated. Stacks.

46.d: Whenever the Bladedancer kills an enemy, the Bladedancer's resolve is increased by +1 until the end of combat.

47.d: The Bladedancer deals an additional +(5 + Bladedancer's WS bonus)% damage against enemies armed with a melee weapon.

48.d: At the beginning of the Master Tactician's turn, if their momentum is higher than 125, the first burst attack or area attack used by the master tactician this turn costs -1 less AP (minimum 0).

50.d: The character gains a bonus to their Strength equal to 20% of their maximum wounds.
The Bladedancer's maximum wounds are increased by +(Bladedancer's dodge/10).

51.d: Whenever the Master Tactician's ally uses a heroic act, the Master Tactician gains +5 Fellowship. Whenever their ally uses a desperate measure, the Master Tactician gains +5 Toughness. These bonuses stack and last until the end of combat.

52.d: Any Bladedancer attacks made with a sword deal + AGI bonus% additional damage. This bonus damage is doubled if using a two-handed sword.
When an Imperial world character is affected by an ally's non-damaging ability or affects an ally with such an ability, their resolve is increased by (FEL bonus / 2) for 1 round.

53.d: The Master Tactician suffers direct damage equal to 20% of their maximum wounds, gains Master Tactician's resolve stacks of tactical advantage, and resets the cooldown of Linchpin, Inspire, and Strongpoint. Until the end of the Master Tactician's turn, these abilities can only target the Master Tactician themselves.

54.d: Any damage the character deals is increased by +1 for every attack they have made this combat. Does not affect damage-over-time effects: bleeding, burning, or toxin.

The first time that momentum reaches 200 during the psyker's turn, the psyker gains +5 to all characteristics, +1 to resolve, +1 to deflection, and +1 to all damage that the psyker deals until the end of combat.

builds.title: Gunslinger Executioner
builds.desc: Fortress World - Sanctioned Psyker (Biomancer) - Operative - Ballistic Skill +2 / Agility +2 / Intelligence +1 / Perception +1

4.d: The Operative inflicts an exploit even on enemies which are out of the Operative's line of sight at the start of the turn.

5.d: Each level of psy rating provides the psyker access to new psychic powers. It also strengthens damaging psychic powers. 1.

6.d: On their first turn in combat, the Operative randomly distributes the same number of exploits as when using Analyse Enemies among all enemies in a 10-cell radius around the Operative. At the start of each of the Operative's subsequent turns, they distribute half as many exploits (half the base amount) among all enemies in a 2-cell radius around the Operative.

7.d:
The Operative removes -1 exploit from each enemy in a 5-cell radius around a point within 10 cells from the Operative. If there is only one enemy in the area, the Operative removes all exploit stacks from that enemy.
 All allies gain +(number of removed exploits)% armour until the end of combat. If 4 or more exploits are removed, the Operative gains +(2 x number of removed exploits)% damage until the end of combat.

8.d: Tactical Knowledge requires 3 exploits instead of 4. The Operative's damage is increased by +INT bonus.
All the psyker's attacks, including damaging psychic powers, now poison enemies. This poison deals (4 x psy rating) damage every turn.

11.d: When all stacks of never stop shooting should be lost, they become (WP / 2) number of stacks instead. Additionally, a fortress world character may upgrade their Willpower characteristic even if their current archetypes do not allow it.

12.d:
Enfeeble is a Sanctioned Psyker — Biomancer Ability,
Until the end of combat, all targets within the area suffer a −(5 + 3 × psy rating) penalty to Strength and Agility and +(3 + 2 × psy rating)% increase to all incoming damage.
The character can attack with the second weapon in their current weapon set in addition to the usual one attack per round. This attack suffers a -20 penalty to WS and BS and costs +1 AP more.
12.ru: Бой с применением двух видов оружия

13.d: Each round fortress world characters gain a stacking +1% bonus to dodge against ranged attacks for each shot they made during this round. Also, the burst attack grants an additional +10 stacks of never stop shooting.

14.d: Each level of psy rating provides the psyker access to new psychic powers. It also strengthens damaging psychic powers 2.

17.d:
All enemies suffering from damage-over- time effects in a 4-cell radius around the Executioner immediately suffer an extra instance of damage from these effects.
 They must also pass a resistance test with a -(Medicae / 5) penalty or suffer an additional negative effect. The effect and type of the resistance test depend on the initial damage-over-time effect.
 Bleeding: Agility resistance test, blinded
 Burning: Willpower resistance test, slowed
 Toxin: Toughness resistance test, staggered
 These additional effects are removed at the start of the Executioner's next turn.

18.d: Enemies suffering from any damage-over-time effect inflicted by the Executioner also suffer a — (5 + Medicae/20) penalty to their resistance tests.

21.d: All damage-over-time effects inflicted by the Executioner gain a 20% critical hit chance. This chance is increased by all bonuses to critical hit chance.

22.d:
Warp Speed is a Sanctioned Psyker — Biomancer Ability,
Until the end of combat, the target ally increases their MP by +(3 + psyker's psy rating), their Agility by +(5 + 2 × psyker's psy rating), and their AP by +1.

23.d: The maximum number of wounds for the Executioner depends on their Medicae instead of Toughness.

24.d: Each level of psy rating provides the psyker access to new psychic powers. It also strengthens damaging psychic powers. 3.

25.d: The Executioner deals +5% more damage to a target for each type of damage-over- time effect inflicted on that target.

28.d: The first instance of damage dealt by the Executioner's damage-over-time effects in around reduces the inflicted enemy's armour by — (10 + INT bonus)% until the end of combat. This effect can be inflicted on multiple enemies per round, but only once per enemy. Stacks.

30.d:
The Executioner's next ranged attack or psychic staff ability inflicts a damage-over-time effect on all targets hit. The type of this effect depends on the attack's damage type:
 Physical damage: inflicts toxin
 Energy damage: inflicts burning
 The level of this damage-over-time effect is equal to (minimum weapon damage / 7). This effect is only applied once per target after all other effects from the attack are applied.

31.d: The level of the damage-over-time effect inflicted by the Executioner's Merciless Verdict is increased by +(maximum weapon damage / 5).

33.d: The damage dealt by the Executioner's damage-over-time effects is increased by (medicae / 20)% for every -10% penalty to armour suffered by the target from any source.

34.d: Each level of psy rating provides the psyker access to new psychic powers. It also strengthens damaging psychic powers. 4.

36.d: During the first turn of combat, the character has +2 additional action points.
On the first turn of every combat, all psychic powers of the biomancy discipline cost -1 action point.

37.d: At the start of their turn, an enemy suffering from burning inflicted by the Executioner must make a Willpower resistance test. If failed, burning is removed and the enemy falls prone until the start of their next turn.

38.d: Drukhari ranged Weapons deal 20% more damage for each dot on enemies

39.d: Until the Operative's next turn, their allies' attacks also remove exploits and deal +INT bonus more damage.

40.d: Whenever the character deals damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the degraded defence effect for every 6 damage that the character has dealt. Whenever an ally attacks that enemy, they deal additional damage equal to the number of degraded defence stacks. (Stacks cap 1000)

If an enemy suffering from any of the Executioner's damage-over-time effects is suffering from bleeding, burning (including the effects inflicted by a pyromancer or a Navigator), and toxin (including the effects inflicted by a biomancer) at the same time, all of these damage-over-time effects deal +30% more damage to that enemy.

41.d: Each round fortress world characters gain a stacking +1% bonus to dodge against ranged attacks for each shot they made during this round. Also, the burst attack grants an additional +10 stacks of never stop shooting.

42.d:
The Executioner replaces (30% of their maximum wounds) of their wounds with
 the same number of temporary wounds until the end of combat.
 While the Executioner has temporary wounds, all of their melee attacks and damage-over-time effects deal an additional +(30% of their maximum wounds)% damage.

43.d: Whenever a single instance of damage from any of the Executioner's damage-over-time effects deals damage equal to or more than 10% of the enemy's maximum wounds, that enemy gains +1 stack of fatigued.
Whenever an effect applied by the psyker increases the damage suffered by a target, this effect is increased by half (for example, a 20% increase turns into a 30% increase).

44.d: Any damage the character deals is increased by +1 for every attack they have made this combat. Does not affect damage-over-time effects: bleeding, burning, or toxin.

46.d: If the Operative attacks a target affected by an exploit from a distance of (15 - PER bonus) cells or farther, that attack deals +15% damage.

47.d: While the Operative's Perception bonus is 10 or higher, they gain +1 AP and ignore enemies' deflection.

48.d: The Executioner's armour is increased by + (5 + maximum wounds/20)%.

50.d: If the character's dodge reduction is higher than the enemy's dodge, the character's damage against that enemy is increased by +1% for every 5% difference between the character's dodge reduction and the enemy's dodge.
Expose Weakness also reduces enemies' Toughness and Willpower by -(3 X INT bonus) for 1 round.

51.d: Whenever an enemy suffering from any of the Executioner's damage-over-time effects dodges the Executioner's attack, all damage-over-time effects currently inflicted on that enemy now deal an additional +10% damage. Stacks.

52.d: Whenever the Operative triggers an exploit on an enemy, the Operative gains +1 damage and +2% armour penetration until the end of combat. Stacks.

Fortress world characters gain +7 to Ballistic Skill, Perception, and Willpower while in combat. Yet while out of combat, their Intelligence, Fellowship, Perception, and Willpower are decreased by -7.
Character gains +7 to skill and can improve the skill even if their archetype or origin does not allow it

53.d: The Executioner immediately inflicts bleeding (5) on an ally of their choice (including themselves). That ally gains a +(5 + Medicae / 10)% bonus to dodge and +3 additional MP until bleeding ends for any reason.

54.d: The character's attacks gain an additional +(BS / 2)% overpenetration. Their overpenetration attacks cannot be dodged.
Whenever the character scores a critical hit, they have a chance to increase their critical damage bonus by half. That chance is equal to (character's critical chance - 50)% (minumum of 0%).

At the start of the Operative's turn, the enemy with the largest number of exploits receives an additional exploit stack. If two or more enemies are tied for the largest number of exploit stacks, one of those enemies is chosen at random.
